
# @hexa-ui/components
The **@hexa-ui/components** project is responsible for implementing the Hexa components in React. It provides a library of reusable UI components that follow the Hexa design system guidelines. These components are designed to be flexible, customizable, and easy to use, allowing developers to quickly build user interfaces with consistent styling and behavior.

By using **@hexa-ui/components**, developers can leverage a wide range of pre-built components such as buttons, forms, modals, navigation elements, and more. These components are designed to be modular and can be easily integrated into existing React projects. They also come with a set of props and options that allow for customization and adaptation to specific project requirements.

The project aims to simplify the development process by providing a consistent and cohesive set of UI components that adhere to the Hexa design principles. This ensures a seamless user experience across different applications and promotes efficient collaboration between designers and developers. With **@hexa-ui/components**, developers can focus on building functionality while relying on a robust and visually appealing component library.

## Stack
- [Vanilla-extract](https://vanilla-extract.style/)
- [Rollup](https://github.com/rollup/rollup)
- [Jest](https://jestjs.io/)
- [React Testing Library](https://github.com/testing-library/react-testing-library)

## Installing

Install @hexa-ui/components using yarn, npm or pnpm.

```bash
yarn add @hexa-ui/components
```

If your project is already using version 2 of @hexa-ui/components and you cannot replace it with version 3, you will need to create an alias to install the package.

To create an alias for the @hexa-ui/components package, you can use the yarn command bellow. This command installs the lastest version of the package as `@hexa-ui/components2`, allowing you to install both versions side-by-side.

```bash
yarn add @hexa-ui/components2@npm:@hexa-ui/components@latest
```


## Usage

```typescript
import { Button } from '@hexa-ui/components';

function Component() {
  return <Button>Click here</Button>;
};
```
